notes.title: Car Demolition Clicker patch 1.02.01 live!
notes.content:
Game have just been updated to version 1.02.01

Fixes and adjustments:
- fixed problem with "Hit the tires" quest on pickup vehicle
- fixed problem with wrong level load of 3rd drone at max level
- adjusted drones levels, power output and cost

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821298/dbf0137755fb035c34641027d495f7d17ec91627.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.02 is live
notes.content:
New patch containing some adjustments and new content is now live. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821298/404050c2e73f982e999f99ee069cf69fc67b2122.jpg[/img]

New Content:
- New "Burned" Mission added

Adjustments:
- Totem is now adjusted to be bit stronger on early stages and nerfed in late game
- Red 4-gun drone now gains cash correctly
- Last drone level capacity increased to 19999 from 9999
- Leaderboards got cleared from wrong hi-scores


Thank you all for playing the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.01 "Darkside" is live
notes.content:
New patch containing some fixes, adjustments and new content is now live. 

Thanks to our community we located and fixed some issues in CDC. We will keep on upgrading and making CDC a better game with your support.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30821298/7e8d6c12d2adc2931aa9abb90c6b8bc402741d91.png[/img]

Game will update save file variables and make a free auto Power Reset. It will also keep diamonds and Power Reset count.
As bonus for this we are giving 250 diamonds to all who had this issue.

Fixes:
- achievement "Perfectionst" not unlocking fixed
- rain, xray and neon signs now have turned off sound effects if applicable
- fixed problem with not saved windowed mode option
- cars count now reset to 0 correctly after Power Reset
- fixed problem with HP, DMG and other values going into negative stats when integer values were to high
- fixed problem with Endless mode stopping on cycle 278

New Content:
- Number of completed Endless Cycles now shows in Endless mode
- Number of done Power Resets is now shown in Map Menu
- New Mission after completing quest mode - optional "Burned Mission" with Darkside vehicle boss battle + new achievement for defeating Darkside.
- Option to turn off camera shake in pause menu

Adjustments:
- Bulldozer boss now have different color palette and have more targetable armor parts
- Totem is now much stronger on higher levels (boost on lvl 500, 750 and 1500)
- More boss models and stages in Endless mode
- Tutorial mode is turned off after beating 1st stage
- Final weapon "The Chaos Engine" now cost 250 diamonds
- Endless mode - Boss HP, Boss Attack DMG, Car HP multipliers are a bit higher with later Endless cycles


Thank you all for you patience. We will bring more content and will update the game when needed.
